**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall." Both preferred elements are met on the face of the clause.
- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** — Vendor affirmatively acknowledges Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, reinforcing the position.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars any minimum-use charge not identified in the Order Form.
- No take-or-pay, committed-spend, shortfall, non-cancellable/non-refundable, or usage-cap mechanic appears anywhere in the document, so the fallback true-up and reduction mechanics are unnecessary. No redline proposed.
